item.title: Guarding the Church from False Unity
item.description: Dave Jenkins explains how churches can guard against false unity by rooting fellowship in biblical truth, sound doctrine, and the gospel from Ephesians 4:1–6.

item.title: Job 23 — When God Feels Hidden, Yet He Knows Our Way
item.description: A devotional walk through Job 23 showing that even when God feels hidden, He knows our way and refines His people like gold through trials.

item.title: Suffering Is Not Wasted: God’s Purpose in Trials
item.description: Suffering is something every believer will face, yet Scripture teaches that it is never wasted in the hands of a sovereign and good God. In this episode of Equipping You in Grace, Dave Jenkins explains how God uses trials to strengthen faith, refine character, and anchor believers in a hope that does not disappoint.
